issue.body:
# R0023 — Preserve location intent, fix accuracy and acquisition age through the weather pipeline

Canonical identity: **theislampill/salah_widget R0023**. Baseline `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`. Future implementation work order; no production location behaviour changed by publication.

A saved browser-derived coordinate can still be described as precise GPS even though its measured accuracy and acquisition time were discarded. An IP centroid or place coordinate also cannot support the same “here now” weather claim as a sufficiently accurate, relevant site. Preserve what the location actually means before adding hyperlocal precipitation inference.

## Current chain and evidence

[config.geolocate](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L208) and [builder location](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L373) both use `enableHighAccuracy:false, timeout:10000, maximumAge:600000`. Shared geolocation returns `coords.accuracy` but not `position.timestamp`; widget `_usePrecise` converts only lat/lon to form fields, and builder directly drops both metadata values. No `watchPosition` exists.

[saveLocal/loadLocal](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L140) retain a settings-write `savedAt`, not a fix timestamp, with no fix-age check. Source becomes localStorage and original source is stored separately. Settings conversion/portable serialization can discard metadata. Typed place and manual coordinates collapse into manual source; five decimals convey formatting, not measured accuracy. A label-only edit can change provenance despite unchanged coordinates. Coarse-IP helper may return provider/accuracy/area, but no end-to-end precision contract exists.

These are source-traced findings, not a live GPS accuracy, host permission or mobile test. [Geolocation's contract](https://www.w3.org/TR/geolocation/) distinguishes cached-position age, reported accuracy and a high-accuracy hint; none proves that the viewer remains at a stored coordinate.

## Desired invariant

The weather consumer can identify the **selected target and intent**, original acquisition source, reported accuracy with known units or unknown, acquisition time or unknown, and persistence time separately. Saving unrelated settings cannot refresh a fix. A fixed configured site does not become stale merely because it is old. A saved device position must not silently claim to be the device's current position.

Represent at least: explicit configured site; fresh browser position; saved browser position with age; coarse-IP area/centroid; selected place/postcode; unresolved/legacy origin. Browser-position freshness is a policy-qualified statement, not a synonym for “saved recently.” Do not invent an IP accuracy radius, call every browser fix GPS, or infer precision from decimal places.

## Implementation sequence

1. Read current config normalization/resolve/save/load/serialize and widget/builder acquisition/form writers. Re-anchor ownership interfaces from R000F/10/11/1F. Define a small serializable location-evidence structure; keep target coordinates separate from evidence about the viewer's presence there.
2. Capture finite `coords.accuracy` in metres and the actual `position.timestamp` at successful browser acquisition. Retain acquisition source and time through both widget and builder paths. Reject malformed metadata as unknown without converting it to zero accuracy or a current timestamp. Do not let an old result win a newer location intent; that is R000F's existing contract.
3. Preserve original fix metadata across unrelated label/unit/method saves. Coordinate edits create explicit site/manual intent and clear incompatible acquisition claims. Place selection retains actual available granularity/bounds; absent source metadata remains unknown. Reverse naming cannot improve accuracy. Preserve IP metadata only with verified semantics; unverified units remain explicitly unknown.
4. Migrate old saved configs conservatively: retain usable coordinates/preferences, mark acquisition evidence unknown or legacy, and never substitute savedAt for fix time. If storage fails, retain accurate in-memory evidence and truthful feedback under R0011.
5. Define portable serialization deliberately: portable hashes describe a configured destination, not the recipient's current device position. Do not leak unnecessary fine-grained acquisition metadata into copied URLs. Local persistence may retain the original fix privately; serialize only what the consumer needs to distinguish fixed-site versus local-mode intent. Preserve325×530 embed size and existing preference precedence.
6. Expose only decision-useful location diagnostics and update affected pin/status copy, README recipient disclosure and config documentation. “Browser position”/“saved position” are conceptual distinctions; choose concise final wording in the implementation, not a new settings redesign.

Keep acquisition one-shot and user-triggered. The existing10-minute cache allowance and high-accuracyfalse are not themselves proven bugs. Do not change them automatically, add continuous GPS, prompt on every refresh, demand precise location for fixed sites or alter prayer method selection. A deliberate refresh can obtain a new fix if the user needs current-device weather; actual acceptable accuracy depends on the precipitation product's spatial scale.

## Tests and acceptance

Use mocked browser positions, not the owner's location. Positive fixture: `{latitude:52.52,longitude:13.41,accuracy:25,timestamp:T}` yields exactly25m andT through acquire→form→apply→save→load. Save a label/units change atT+1day: acquisition remainsT; settings savedAt changes independently. A five-minute cached position may be returned under existing options and must retain its original timestamp. A stale saved fix remains a saved target, not a fresh position.

Negative fixtures: missing/NaN/negative accuracy; missing/future timestamp; permission denied; timeout; provider unavailable; coarse-IP result with null/ambiguous accuracy; geocoder area without precision; manual lat/lon at five decimals; label-only edit; coordinate edit after GPS; late old request; legacy saved config; blocked/partitioned storage. Unknown metadata remains unknown and no denied request triggers automatic retry/prompt loops. Define and document future-timestamp skew handling from the actual clock contract, not a silent age0 clamp.

Verify explicit hardcoded hash, local mode, preferLocal, builder preview and copy snippet. A portable recipient sees the selected fixed site, never a false claim that a sender's fix is the recipient's current position. Do not change method/unit preference precedence or clear usable saved data during migration.

Iframe controls: top-level, delegated local embed, absent delegation and restrictive parent policy, using permission mocks or a controlled test host. Existing local snippets/preset already include `allow="geolocation"`; [Permissions Policy](https://www.w3.org/TR/permissions-policy/) and user grant still apply. No real owner permission interaction is required. Mobile sensor/battery behaviour remains later device evidence if not available.

Pass when end-to-end diagnostics explain target/source/known accuracy/fix age without invented precision, saved coordinates remain usable, current-device claims are honest, no continuous tracking is added, and downstream weather classification can distinguish precise/site/coarse/unknown inputs. Keep a small browser integration proof of the actual form/persistence path; a pure helper test alone cannot catch dropped fields.

## Ownership, dependency and rollback

[R000F](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/15) owns latest query/edit/session results; [R0010](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/16) owns explicit preferences; [R0011](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/17) owns persistence outcome; [R001F](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/31) owns coarse-response lifetime and preservation of returned metadata. This issue owns the **end-to-end meaning and lifecycle** of acquisition evidence. It must not duplicate their repair algorithms. [R001B](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/27) owns actual network-recipient disclosure; no extra provider is introduced here.

The new precipitation-evidence model consumes this interface. Freeze the location record and legacy semantics before integrating that consumer. Source/metadata work may be reasoned about independently, but shared config.js, builder and index form writers require serialized integration with the existing owners. No hard dependency requires every unrelated corrective issue to finish.

Rollback metadata/UI changes without deleting usable coordinates/preferences. A downgraded or older consumer must see a configured site/unknown evidence, not false fresh GPS. Stop if a proposed migration loses locations, copied URLs expose unnecessary private history, or weather semantics demand continuous tracking. Done requires exact-candidate end-to-end evidence and honest legacy degradation, not a successful geolocation callback alone.
